Collaborative excellence : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued. Inclusive Culture: Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation. Career growth : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth. Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health. Productivity tools : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency. Job Description: About the Role: We are seeking an experienced and highly driven professional to lead the end-to-end development, launch, scaling, and operationalization of innovative technology products that require significant software development and hardware integration. The Project Manager serves as the primary leader responsible for transforming business concepts into market-ready solutions, overseeing the entire product lifecycle from business case development and roadmap definition through design, development, deployment, and ongoing operations. The successful candidate will combine strong project and program management capabilities with a deep understanding of software engineering practices, systems integration, and hardware-enabled solutions. They will effectively bridge business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and operations organizations to ensure successful delivery of complex technology products. Key responsibilities: Product Strategy & Planning Lead the translation of business opportunities into executable product development programs . Define product vision, roadmap, business objectives , success metrics, and launch strategies. Develop and manage business cases, investment plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements. Collaborate with executive leadership to align product initiatives with strategic business goals. Program & Project Leadership Own the end-to-end delivery of complex technology products from concept through commercialization. Manage cross-functional teams including product managers, software engineers, hardware engineers, quality assurance, operations, and external vendors. Establish and maintain project governance, risk management, reporting, and decision-making processes. Monitor scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, and resource utilization . Software Development Management Possess a detailed understanding of modern software development methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, cybersecurity, and quality assurance practices. Partner closely with development teams to evaluate technical solutions, development plans, architecture decisions, and release strategies. Ensure product requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and successfully translated into technical deliverables. Identify and mitigate technical risks and delivery challenges. Hardware & Systems Integration Oversee integration of hardware, devices, sensors, IoT components, communications infrastructure, and third-party systems. Coordinate validation, testing, interoperability, performance verification, and deployment readiness activities. Ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and software platforms. Manage vendor relationships and technical integration partners. Product Launch & Scaling Develop and execute go-to-market and deployment strategies. Lead pilot programs, customer acceptance testing, launch readiness reviews, and production deployments. Define operational support models and transition products into sustainable operations. Drive continuous improvement, product evolution, and scalability initiatives. Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary liaison between business leadership and technical teams. Communicate program status, key decisions, risks, and mitigation plans to executive stakeholders. Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities. Facilitate strategic and technical decision-making processes. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering , Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in product development, technology program management, or related leadership roles in the transportation industry . Demonstrated success delivering complex products involving both software development and hardware integration. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, cloud platforms, integration patterns, and DevOps practices. Experience leading cross-functional product and engineering teams. Proven track record managing large-scale programs with significant budgets and multiple stakeholders. Monitor system health and proactively investigate application issues and production incidents. Serve as a senior-level technical escalation point for complex software and application support issues. Investigate root causes and manage resolution of application, integration, and system issues. Partner with software engineering teams to investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions that improve the reliability and performance of applications. Answer functional and technical inquiries from support teams and business users regarding application behavior and system functionality. Solve application, data, integration, and performance-related issues across a complex enterprise environment. Ensure data issues are accurately resolved while following ITIL procedures for managing updates. Participate in a rotating after-hours support schedule for critical production incidents. Collaborate with Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Business Analysts, and Support teams to ensure application stability and reliability. Review proposed code changes and provide feedback regarding production impact, system behavior, and supportability. Document findings, resolutions, guidelines, and known issues. Share technical knowledge and mentor team members on application functionality and techniques to fix issues. Find opportunities to improve monitoring, support processes, operational efficiency, and system reliability. Qualifications and Requirements: Extensive experience supporting applications built on UniData, UniBasic, or other Pick-based technologies. Strong experience resolving complex application and production support issues in enterprise environments. Demonstrable ability to perform root cause analysis and drive complex issue resolution across multiple teams. Experience providing support for applications that use APIs and web services. Experience interacting with Oracle and/or SQL Server databases. Experience working in multi-server environments. Good understanding of high-volume transaction processing environments. Experience with UniData file structures, dictionaries, triggers, and multi-level files. Ability to analyze application behavior, troubleshoot code, and recommend technical solutions. Job Description: The Senior Project Development Manager – Energy Storage Technologies role at Ferrovial Energy is responsible for originating, developing, evaluating, acquiring, and advancing utility-scale energy storage opportunities across the U.S. and Canada. The role will focus on a broad range of storage technologies, including lithium-ion battery storage, thermal storage, iron-based storage, vanadium redox flow batteries, and other emerging short-duration and long-duration energy storage solutions. The position will support standalone storage, renewable-plus-storage hybrid projects, behind-the-meter and front-of-the-meter applications, data center energy infrastructure solutions, and other strategic storage opportunities aligned with Ferrovial Energy’s growth objectives. The position will be based at the Ferrovial Energy US headquarters in Austin, TX, and reports to the Director, Project Development. You will work closely with the U.S. Development team, finance, M&A, engineering, commercial, legal, construction, asset management, and corporate strategy teams. The Senior Manager will identify and secure new sites, evaluate technology and market opportunities, lead commercial and technical due diligence, support acquisitions and partnership structures, build relationships with technology providers and developers, and prepare executive-level materials for investment decisions, business planning, and management updates. The goal is to build a differentiated energy storage pipeline that supports grid reliability, renewable integration, customer load growth, data center power needs, and long-term value creation for Ferrovial Energy. RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as project lead for standalone energy storage, hybrid renewable-plus-storage, and data center-related energy infrastructure opportunities, coordinating internal cross-functional teams and external consultants across development, interconnection, permitting, land, engineering, finance, legal, commercial, construction, and asset management workstreams. Originate, screen, and advance energy storage projects across multiple technologies, including lithium-ion batteries, thermal storage, iron-based storage, vanadium redox flow batteries, and other emerging short-duration and long-duration storage solutions. Evaluate market applications for storage projects, including resource adequacy, capacity, ancillary services, congestion management, renewable integration, curtailment mitigation, resiliency, microgrids, tolling structures, data center power solutions, and customer-specific energy needs. Lead site identification and project development activities, including land control, permitting strategy, environmental review, stakeholder outreach, community engagement, utility coordination, interconnection strategy, transmission review, and project schedule management. Support commercial, technical, and financial modeling for storage projects, including revenue forecasts, dispatch assumptions, market participation strategies, degradation and augmentation assumptions, lifecycle cost analysis, CAPEX/OPEX estimates, tax credit sensitivity, and investment case preparation. Prepare executive-level briefings, business updates, investment committee materials, project memoranda, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations for senior and executive management. Support M&A, project acquisition, co-development, and joint venture opportunities by leading or contributing to due diligence, valuation inputs, transaction structuring, development risk assessment, technology review, and negotiation support. Develop and manage strategic partnerships with technology suppliers, developers, utilities, load-serving entities, data center customers, EPC contractors, engineering firms, consultants, landowners, public agencies, and financial partners. Manage assigned project budgets, objectives, schedules, development milestones, risk registers, consultant scopes, and internal reporting obligations. Promote a culture of safety, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, and commercial discipline across all project activities. Strong understanding of short-duration and long-duration energy storage technologies, including lithium-ion BESS, thermal storage, iron-based storage, vanadium redox flow batteries, and other emerging storage technologies. Experience developing, acquiring, financing, or evaluating storage projects across the full lifecycle, from origination, market screening, land, interconnection, permitting, and stakeholder outreach through financing, construction readiness, commissioning, and operations support. Demonstrated ability to prepare and interpret project financial models, market models, dispatch scenarios, lifecycle cost comparisons, revenue forecasts, sensitivity analyses, and investment materials for storage assets. Required experience supporting M&A, project acquisitions, co-development structures, joint ventures, partnerships, or strategic investments in energy storage, renewables, data centers, or adjacent energy infrastructure sectors. Ability to prepare clear, concise, and commercially oriented materials for executive management, including investment committee presentations, management updates, project approvals, risk summaries, and strategic recommendations. Strong knowledge of U.S. interconnection and transmission processes across multiple ISO/RTO and utility markets, including queue strategy, grid constraints, congestion, curtailment, capacity markets, ancillary services, storage revenue opportunities, and market-specific rules in regions such as ERCOT, SPP, MISO, PJM, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, WECC, and SERC. Strong stakeholder outreach and communication skills, with the ability to engage landowners, community leaders, local officials, regulators, utilities, customers, industry groups, internal executive stakeholders, and cross-functional internal teams, including other project developers, engineers, EPC, construction, finance, legal, commercial, and asset management personnel. Commercially astute, proactive, collaborative, autonomous, flexible, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate risks, and drive projects forward in a dynamic market environment. title: Credit Products Manager
jd_text: Position Title Credit Products Manager   Location Work From Home TX, TX 73301   Job Summary The Credit Products Manager (CPM) is responsible for overseeing first-line credit underwriting and portfolio management within an assigned business including but not limited to Corporate Banking and Regional Commercial Banking, ensuring alignment with the bank’s risk appetite and business objectives. This role manages a team of underwriters and credit professionals (Credit Products Specialists and Credit Products Analysts), ensuring accurate risk ratings, loan evaluation and underwriting, and ongoing portfolio management. Utilizing data-driven insights and portfolio analytics, a CPM identifies emerging risks and opportunities, providing recommendations to leadership to support sound credit decisions. Collaborating with sales, risk, and technology teams, this role helps drive responsible growth, improve underwriting processes, and enhance credit product offerings. With a focus on operational execution, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement, a CPM plays a key role in maintaining portfolio quality and supporting the bank’s long-term success.   Job Responsibilities: Maintains visibility and deep knowledge of bank relationships within the assigned LOB to ensure alignment with business objectives. Executes on the strategic priorities set by the Head of Credit Products, Line of Business leaders, Credit Products Senior Director and 2nd and 3rd Line Risk partners to ensure alignment with enterprise goals. Proactively identifies and escalates areas for improvement in credit processes, policies and procedures. Maintains the credit quality of assigned portfolios and/or lending verticals by overseeing underwriting, portfolio management, and risk monitoring activities. Establishes and fosters a shared vision across assigned regions and verticals, ensuring consistency in credit decisioning and risk management practices. Attracts, develops, and retains top talent within Credit Products by providing leadership, coaching, and professional development opportunities for underwriters, portfolio managers, and credit analysts. Collaborates closely with Sales, Credit Products, and Risk teams to drive responsible growth, optimize credit decisioning, and enhance portfolio performance. Serves as a key point of contact for deal flow assignment, credit risk reviews, and escalations, ensuring timely and well-informed credit decisions. Leverages data-driven insights and analytics to identify emerging credit risks and opportunities, proactively adjusting strategies as needed. Well versed in legal documentation (e.g., Credit Agreements) and positioned to both develop more junior associates on the topic and interact with internal and external legal counsel and negotiate terms directly with clients. Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk frameworks while supporting continuous process improvements. Provides credit risk reporting and analysis to senior leadership, contributing to portfolio strategy and risk management discussions. Partners with legal and compliance teams to ensure underwriting and portfolio management practices align with all regulatory requirements. Supports senior leadership in delivering portfolio analysis and reporting, contributing to strategic decision-making. Recruits, develops and trains top credit underwriting and portfolio management talent. ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES Performs special projects, to include continuous improvement and transformation initiatives, and additional duties and responsibilities as required. Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. jd_text: Job Description Summary Product quality review associated with the manufacturing process. Impacts the team’s ability to achieve service, quality and timeliness of objectives. Job Description Work Location and Travel Remote eligible with a preference for candidates in the Northeast United States due to GE locations supported Ability to travel to supported GE Sites: Bromont, Hookset, Rutland Typical travel: 25% Roles and Responsibilities Safety Management System Implementation (Policy) – Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of the site’s SMS in alignment with enterprise SMS team and industry best practices. Ensure SMS documentation is accurate, accessible, and maintained. Safety Risk Management (SRM) – Facilitate risk identification, analysis, and mitigation through collaboration with site product Safety Action Team (SAT)/Groups and product Safety Review Boards (SRB). Incident Investigation and Reporting – Prepare and submit product safety performance reports to the Accountable SMS Delegate, safety review board, and enterprise SMS team as required. Conduct regular product safety audits and inspections to ensure adherence to SMS requirements. Promote product safety awareness and a culture of continuous improvement. Collaboration and Communication (Product Safety Promotion) – Facilitate the distribution of product safety information. title: Embedded Computing Research Engineer - Embedded Systems
jd_text: Job Description Summary As an Embedded Computing Research Engineer at GE Vernova’s Advanced Research Center, you will develop, implement, and test edge solutions for embedded systems that power industrial automation, networking, and enterprise software platforms. You will contribute hands-on across the full development lifecycle, from concept and architecture through implementation, integration, and verification. You will help execute multimillion-dollar research and development programs aligned with GE Vernova’s energy businesses, including Power, Wind, Electrification, and Grid Solutions, as well as U.S. Government agencies such as the Department of Defense and Department of Energy. The technologies you develop will be matured and transitioned into GE Vernova products. You will collaborate with teams across GE Vernova, suppliers, government partners, national laboratories, universities, and strategic business partners to advance innovative embedded computing solutions. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Develop, implement, and test edge and embedded software solutions for industrial automation, networking, and enterprise software platforms. Serve as a technical contributor on R&D tasks, translating program requirements into robust embedded-system designs and implementation plans. Develop firmware and application software in C/C++ and related languages for resource-constrained, real-time embedded platforms. Build, execute, and automate test plans, including unit, integration, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level verification. Support the maturation and transition of research prototypes into GE Vernova product platforms. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, suppliers, national laboratories, universities, and government partners to deliver program milestones. Contribute to proposals, technical reports, and program reviews for internal leadership and government sponsors. Apply secure-by-design principles and cybersecurity best practices throughout the embedded-software lifecycle. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with 1–5 years of relevant industry experience. A minimum of 1 year of professional experience in embedded systems, firmware, or edge software development. Demonstrated proficiency in embedded software development using C and/or C++. Experience with microcontrollers, microprocessors, or system-on-chip platforms and associated hardware interfaces, such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, or Ethernet. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 61850, MQTT, or BACnet, and data-serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers or JSON. Ability to integrate existing real-time analytics, anomaly-detection capabilities, and secure data pipelines into edge and embedded applications. Experience developing for Linux systems or real-time operating systems. Experience across the embedded-systems development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Desired Characteristics Familiarity with industrial control systems, programmable logic controllers, or edge controllers used in grid operations, industrial automation, or renewable-energy infrastructure. Experience with RTOS task scheduling, thread priorities, and strict timing deadlines. Full-stack programming experience delivering edge-to-cloud solutions. Experience developing for real-time operating systems and/or bare-metal environments. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of memory management and pointer manipulation. Knowledge of asymmetric and symmetric multiprocessing concepts, virtual memory, and their real-time implications. Experience developing test automation, build scripts, and rapid prototypes using Python or other scripting languages. Working knowledge of embedded cybersecurity, secure boot, cryptographic primitives, or industrial control and operational technology security standards, such as IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript for front-end development and C++ or Python for integration with system-level services or embedded APIs. Experience with CI/CD environments such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Familiarity with multithreaded applications and computer networking. Familiarity with Xilinx and/or Intel (Altera) FPGA devices, tools, and ecosystems, such as ModelSim, Intel Quartus, or Xilinx Vivado. Knowledge of digital logic design, including finite-state machines, pipelining, and resource optimization. Experience with high-speed and standard interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, PCIe, or DDR. Experience developing testbenches and performing functional verification. Knowledge of clock-domain crossing techniques and metastability mitigation. Experience with FPGA or ASIC design using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL. Experience with the FPGA design flow, including simulation, synthesis, place and route, static timing analysis, and timing closure. Collaborate with platform, cloud, network, and security teams on scalability and production readiness. Contribute reusable patterns, standards, and development methodology across GF. 6. jd_text: What makes Gartner for Finance Leaders a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner for Finance Leaders, you’ll set your career on track for outstanding achievement with a company that knows no limits. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Gartner Executive Finance Partners serve as trusted advisors to our members (clients) who are CFOs from Global 1000 organizations and government agencies. Our Associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional career development as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be. About this role: We are specifically looking for a current or prior Federal Government CFO to join the team and provide their expertise and guidance to a portfolio of members operating in the same space. The Executive Finance Partner’s (EFP) role is to engage each member-client, and to help them identify key initiatives to achieve specific enterprise goals. Partnering with the member can include activities such as: defining, developing, coaching and/or critiquing strategies; helping develop and/or transform their organizations; assisting/advising with the development and execution of vision & strategy; aggregating and delivering Gartner research insights on key initiatives, priorities, and implementations; and in general, becoming a trusted advisor for the client CFO. With the support of their Executive Partner, our clients are able to achieve their goals quicker and more cost effectively and with a higher assurance of success. What you’ll do: Relationship Management The Executive Partner manages a portfolio of senior executive member relationships and participates in account planning with Senior Client Managers and Senior Account Executives. These three roles collectively and individually have responsibility for each assigned account. The Executive Partner participates in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal. The Executive Partner conducts monthly consultations with the CFO client, brings the power of Gartner’s service, research and advisory to each client, conducts workshops for the client member, leads CFO activities at the annual Gartner Finance Executive Conference and leads CFO breakout sessions during annual Finance Forums. Program Delivery Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Gartner Sales strategy and Gartner Finance product deliverables. Work with members across the Federal Government to further their levels of Finance maturity through delivery of research, peer networking, and coaching. Critique client strategies, guide clients in building their organizations, and assist in developing Finance strategies, establishing priorities, and planning for implementation around key Finance initiatives. Establish and maintain working relationships with various internal groups to create a comprehensive, well designed sustainable set of key deliverables for clients (including targeted research, personal coaching sessions, scripted analyst sessions, involvement with appropriate events, etc.) Direct and facilitate member peer group calls and/or meetings Service, Sales and Marketing Support The Executive Partner is responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Finance in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities Virtual and in- person interactions The Executive Partner is responsible for hosting and /or participating in periodic virtual or in-person member activities, including workshops, research analyst engagements (where appropriate), round-tables and webinars (in collaboration with Gartner Research) Research Support The Executive Partner supports research activities, such as facilitating member participation in research studies or case panels. The Executive Partner will be aligned with and leverage Gartner research positions and initiatives as well as provide feedback from the member base to the research organization. The Executive Partner works with research analysts to develop and deliver CFO relevant research. Content Development and Management Participate in presentations, panels and workshops Participate in relevant research communities to keep topic area knowledge current and share member experiences with analysts Facilitate member interaction and collaboration through the Sales community portal and assisted member connections Lead and participate in local events and roundtables What you’ll need: Subject Matter Expertise The Executive MUST be a Federal Government CFO (current or former) with demonstrated topic knowledge in developing and delivering overall Financial strategy, execution and performance improvement. You will have a broad base of expertise and will have operated at a executive leadership level and driven change at all levels. Must have a solid understanding of accounting and finance. Prior consulting experience is a plus. The Executive Partner is responsible to retain clients in accordance with established Gartner Retention Metrics. In addition, to work closely with Sales to vet and close “new’ CFO business. Key areas of coverage: CFO Personal Impact and Effectiveness Finance Org Structure and Finance Talent ERP and Finance Technology / Digitization Financial Data & Analytics Cost and Capital Management Solid understanding of Audit and the impact to the CFO’s company Other requirements A university graduate in Finance or Accounting; MBA is a plus MUST have held the title of CFO at a Federal agency d Prior consulting experience is a plus An in-depth understanding of the Finance Function and the role of the CFO In depth understanding of the business value of Finance and Accounting and the alignment of Business and Finance strategies Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to assess member situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business advice & guidance Ability to lead and manage ambiguous situations Candidates must have excellent interpersonal skills; with a healthy dose of humility and experience working with C level executives. This individual should have strong reflective listening skills and the ability to adjust to client cues and needs Superior verbal and written communication skills and strong facilitation and presentation skills Sales savvy Collaboration and ability to influence Sales and / or business development experience or ability with CXO level executives Strong time / project management skills / must be detail oriented Initial Travel restricted to US and Canada; virtual first with potential for up to 25% travel What we offer: In addition to an outstanding work environment with excellent growth potential, Gartner for Finance Leaders provides exceptional compensation and benefits, including: Competitive base salary Annual bonus potential Excellent benefits package About Gartner: Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading research and advisory company. We help business leaders across all major functions in every industry and enterprise size with the objective insights they need to make the right decisions. Our comprehensive suite of services delivers strategic advice and proven best practices to help clients succeed in their mission-critical priorities. Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, USA, and has more than 13,000 associates serving clients in 11,000 enterprises in 100 countries. For more information, visit gartner.com. title: GE Turboshaft Engines (T700) - Depot Subject Matter Expert Shop Floor (w/m/x)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Depot Subject Matter Expert provides depot-level technical expertise for T700/CT7 engine maintenance, repair, inspection, assembly/disassembly, troubleshooting, and test activities. This role supports both hands-on shop execution and quality/engineering-focused evaluation of maintenance activities, ensuring work is performed in accordance with technical directives, approved procedures, and operational requirements. This role also helps develop workforce capability by coaching and training customer personnel on quality systems, supporting documentation, workstation development, heavy machine operation, and technical discipline. Job Description Role Overview GE Aerospace is seeking a T700/CT7 (Turboshaft) Depot Subject Matter Expert - Shop Floor to support hands-on depot execution for T700/CT7 engines, modules, and components. This role is ideal for a practical engine maintenance professional who brings deep shop knowledge, strong technician instincts, and a commitment to safe, disciplined execution. You will help drive daily maintenance activity across inspection, disassembly, assembly, tooling, support equipment, and test stand support while coaching personnel and helping the team solve issues quickly and effectively. This role is full time, on-site at customer facility located in Deblin, Poland. Key Responsibilities · Support depot maintenance execution for T700-GE-701C/D, CT7-2E1 and CT7-8E engines, modules, and components across inspection, disassembly, assembly, repair support, and final preparation activities. · Assist with removal, installation, inspection, repairs, and modifications using approved maintenance procedures and sound workmanship practices. · Train the customer and support engine and module disassembly and assembly activities with focus on task discipline, cleanliness, hardware accountability, and safe execution. · Support movement, handling, preservation, storage, and transportation preparation of engines and engine modules as required by depot operations. · Assist with installation and removal of engines on test stands and support engine operation, evaluation, and testing activities with the appropriate customer teams. · Inspect, maintain, and train customer on engine ground support equipment and related support equipment needed for maintenance execution. · Assist in selection and use of special tools, hand tools, fixtures, and test equipment correctly, and help reinforce proper use, care, and readiness of shop assets. · Provide hands-on coaching and on-the-job training to customer personnel to strengthen technician capability and execution consistency. · Help identify and resolve shop floor issues involving tooling, equipment readiness, workflow interruptions, or technical execution barriers. · Work closely with GE internal and customer operations, quality, and engineering teams to maintain safe, efficient, and compliant maintenance flow. Basic Qualifications · Demonstrated experience in T700/CT7 engine maintenance, depot operations, or closely related turboshaft engine shop activity. · Hands-on experience with engine or module inspection, assembly, disassembly, and maintenance execution in a controlled shop environment. · Ability to interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, and maintenance instructions and apply them accurately on the shop floor. · Experience supporting troubleshooting, repair activity, or maintenance task completion on turbine engines or related systems. · Experience using tooling, fixtures, support equipment, and test equipment relevant to engine depot maintenance and handling activity. · Working knowledge of safe work practices, tool control, hardware accountability, and procedural compliance in maintenance operations. · Ability to provide effective on-the-job training, technician coaching, and practical execution guidance. Preferred Qualifications · Experience supporting shop operations, production flow, military or depot sustainment programs, or complex maintenance environments utilizing FLIGHT DECK or similar lean operating system. · Background in test operations, equipment readiness, engine handling, or support equipment maintenance. · Demonstrated tooling discipline and ability to reinforce efficient, organized, and repeatable work practices. · Experience working within matrix operations, quality, engineering, and support functions to remove barriers and solve issues quickly. · Ability to contribute to continuous improvement, daily execution rhythm, and practical shop floor problem solving. · Experience leading by example in workmanship, safe execution, technician development, and task accountability. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means helping the customer depot team execute hands-on engine maintenance with strong safety, quality, and workflow discipline. You will bring practical shop leadership, support reliable use of tools and equipment, coach technicians in the moment, and help keep engine and module work moving efficiently from receiving, inspection, and teardown through test and final preparation. Customer will take away a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to properly utilize and implement FLIGHT DECK tools in response to shop identified concerns. title: HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (all genders)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description Join GE Vernova and help shape the future of energy. At GE Vernova Grid Solutions , we are advancing the energy transition by delivering innovative technologies and large-scale projects that strengthen and modernize power grids. As our HVDC business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (all genders) to join our Construction & Commissioning team in Central Europe. In this role, you will supervise the installation of HVDC valves, valve cooling systems and high-voltage primary equipment on our large-scale HVDC projects, ensuring safe, high-quality and timely execution by our installation subcontractors. This is a site-based position with functional leadership responsibilities, without direct reports. Your Impact Installation Supervision & Coordination Supervise the mechanical and electrical installation of HVDC valves, valve cooling systems and high-voltage primary equipment performed by subcontractors. Coordinate daily installation activities with site management, engineering teams, suppliers and installation partners. Monitor installation progress, identify potential delays and support corrective actions to keep activities on schedule. Provide technical guidance to subcontractors and resolve installation-related issues in collaboration with internal experts. Ensure that installation teams follow approved technical documentation, drawings and procedures. Quality & EHS Ensure that all installation activities comply with applicable health, safety and environmental (EHS) requirements. Conduct inspections in accordance with Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and verify installation quality against project specifications. Review installation documentation, inspection records, test reports and as-built drawings. Coordinate with internal valve manufacturing teams to ensure the availability and correct use of technical documentation. Promote a strong safety culture, proactively identify risks and stop unsafe activities when necessary. What You Bring Technical qualification in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in electrical or mechanical installation works. Severak years of experience in installation supervision, site management or construction activities within large-scale electrical or industrial projects. Experience with high-voltage equipment, substations, GIS, AIS, FACTS or HVDC projects is highly desirable. Good understanding of mechanical and electrical installation processes, technical drawings, quality inspections and site safety requirements. Experience coordinating subcontractors and working with multidisciplinary site teams. Strong communication, problem-solving and organizational skills, with a proactive and hands-on approach. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Willingness to work on project construction sites and travel or relocate temporarily according to project requirements. What We Offer Impactful Projects: Contribute to major HVDC projects supporting the energy transition and strengthening Europe's power grid. Professional Development: Grow your technical expertise through challenging projects, training and collaboration with experienced specialists. International Environment: Work alongside diverse teams and experts across our global Grid Solutions organization. Ownership & Collaboration: Take responsibility for your area of expertise within a supportive and solution-oriented team. Competitive Rewards: Attractive compensation and corporate benefits within a growing global energy technology business. Ready to make an impact? Join GE Vernova and help build the power grids of tomorrow. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

title: Lead Generator Diagnostic and Robotics Specialist
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Lead Generator Diagnostics and Robotics Specialist – Responsible for providing technical leadership and executing complex electro-mechanical testing (EMT), robotic-assisted inspections, generator diagnostics, and specialized generator monitoring services. This role focuses on Stator Leak Monitoring Systems (SLMS), Rotational Velocity Method (RVM) torsional testing, and the deployment of advanced robotic platforms for internal generator assessments. Operating in fossil and nuclear power stations worldwide, this role involves the installation, calibration, and maintenance of advanced instrumentation, as well as the interpretation of technical data to assess the operational health of turbine-generator equipment. The incumbent serves as a subject matter expert (SME), integrating diagnostic solutions to enhance safety, data accuracy, and operational efficiency, while ensuring all field operations adhere to safety, quality, and schedule commitments. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Technical Execution & Field Operations: Conduct or direct critical generator tests, including SLMS commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Execute RVM torsional vibration measurements, including probe installation, data acquisition, and diagnostic analysis. Deploy and operate robotic inspection systems for internal generator assessments, integrating robotic data outputs with traditional EMT data for comprehensive diagnostic reporting. Commercial Responsibilities: Work directly with Regional Commercial Managers, Service Managers, and Sales Managers to ensure requested workscopes and technical specifications—including robotic service offerings—are reviewed and that I&LES can meet all customer/contract requirements. Perform in-depth research, including review of inspection reports and historical data, and interpret drawings to translate information into accurate inspection requirements. Provide engineering support teams with technical data and knowledge of I&LES service offerings. Work with Product Services to develop enhancements, evaluate new robotic technologies, and streamline procedures for the I&LES commercial process. Coordinate proposal development to ensure customer-required schedule dates are met and quality proposals are issued. Project Management & Administration: Manage costing and proposal development within Workflows, Excel, Access, and SalesForce. Maintain field data, robotic diagnostic logs, and project documentation. Technical Leadership: Provide onsite leadership, mentoring, and training for less experienced personnel. Create technical work instructions and procedures for both traditional EMT and robotic-assisted testing. Lead quality reviews across multiple inspection technologies. Customer Interface: Communicate effectively with internal engineering teams, site representatives, and external customers during planning, execution, and post-job meetings. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college; OR an associate's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Non-Destructive Technology (or equivalent) with at least 5 years of relevant field experience. Technical Expertise: Expertise in generator design principles, generator operation, and electro-mechanical testing. Advanced knowledge in the installation/maintenance of generator monitoring systems (e.g., SLMS, partial discharge (PD), shorted turn, vibration sensors, accelerometers, proximity probes, flow sensors). Proficiency in torsional vibration measurement techniques (e.g., rotary encoders, magnetic pickups, optical sensors) and deployment of remote inspection tools, automated crawlers, or robotic diagnostic platforms. Strong analytical skills regarding rotational velocity and sensor-driven data. Professional Skills: Ability to work well within a short time cycle and high-pressure environments. Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to organize and train team members. Operational Requirements: High Travel: Willingness to travel globally on short notice and for extended periods (70% travel during outage seasons). Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as required by project schedules. Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project Scheduler), Modal Analysis Software, and other applicable data acquisition or robotic interface systems. Desired Characteristics Ability to handle multiple projects concurrently and be very results-oriented. MS in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related discipline. Experience in the use or development of telemetry-based measurement systems. Acoustic, vibration, or mechanical oscillation measurement experience with steam turbine, gas turbine, or generator technology. Proven project management experience executing measurement technology development. Direct experience with field-ready robotic inspection systems in power generation environments. Commitment to teamwork, team success, and strong customer focus. title: Lead P&C Engineer
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Lead Protection & Control Engineer works on T&D substations for AC, HVDC and FACTS projects with designers, peer engineers & leaders. The engineer is responsible to define, design, coordinate all technical aspects of HV / EHV substation protection & control and oversee technical plant integration and optimization at project level considering safety, quality, schedule and cost criteria. The engineer should have great attention to detail with a can-do attitude & customer responsiveness. The Lead Protection & Control Engineer may be identified as project engineer for small to medium size project, which are highly secondary engineering focused. The engineer shall continuously update themselves with new technology and have a mindset of continuous learning, consistent with grid transition needs. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. Functions with some autonomy but guided by established policies or review of end results. Job Description Essential Responsibilities: Ultimately be responsible for design of protection schemes for all kinds of T&D substations, Data Centers, Industrial, BESS applications including one-lines, three-lines, AC / DC schematics, and relay settings. Lead a local or remote design team to develop panel and interconnect wiring as well as panel layouts and elevations Evaluate the interoperability, control features, and communication / protocol aspects of IED’s serving as protection relays to provide an integrated solution including SCADA, Cyber Security and Telecom needs. Be familiar with IEC 61850 process and system bus architecture and its implementation for substations Coordinate with and provide technical assistance to SCADA engineers, substation physical engineers, and control design staff in order to fully develop system integration of protection, control, and monitoring systems. Work with team to meet project specifications, cost control, and schedule objectives Interface with internal and external team members such as Lead engineers, Project Engineers, Electrical Designers, Physical Designers, Draftsmen, Project managers, Sourcing, and support organizations Review power system load flow studies, fault studies, relay setting coordination, and transient studies performed by other agencies Train end-users on the theory, operational use, and maintenance of integrated protection and control systems Lead or support factory acceptance testing and site testing & commissioning Develop outage, cut-over, and testing procedures Define processes, procedures, perform RCA's (Root Cause Analysis), perform corrective actions, and validate process control. Support quality initiatives including aspects of ISO9002 Work on development of proposals including: writing and/or reviewing technical specifications, estimating design man-hours and materials, supporting sourcing for vendor quotations, and the development of clarifications and exceptions as well as technical responses and performing technical validation. Demonstrate leadership behaviors of acting with humility, lead with transparency and deliver with focus Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar degree from an accredited university. Minimum 7 years’ experience in engineering. Minimum 5 years’ experience in protection and controls engineering for substations or power generation. Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% of the time, including international, for meetings and on-site commissioning tests for customer installations and comply with all relevant company travel and tax policies Desired Characteristics: P.E. License or EIT with willingness to pursue and acquire P.E certification or P.Eng or willingness to acquire certification. Extensive experience in protective relaying coordination and practices. Good understanding of circuit breakers, fuses, circuit switchers, transformers, shunt reactors, cap banks, harmonic filters, HVDC and FACTS systems used in the control of power flow, detection and isolation of power system faults. Fluent in English. Strong influencing and relationship building skills. Demonstrated presentation skills and ability to succinctly communicate complex messages. Experience in technical problem solving. Mastering of sec engineering discipline (process, tools and technical aspects) Demonstrates ownership and accountability, judgment and decision making and has passion for the functional role. title: OT Cyber Security SME - ERCIS (M/F/D)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description Summary The Grid Automation (GA) Cybersecurity SME - ERCIS has the mission to contribute to GA growth by assisting in the cybersecurity sales process (including demos and bid responses), as well as the execution and delivery of various cybersecurity offerings at the customer’s locations on an as-needed basis. Le/La Responsable Cybersécurité de Grid Automation (GA) - ERCIS a pour mission de contribuer à la croissance de GA en participant au processus de vente de produits de cybersécurité (y compris les démonstrations et les réponses aux offres), ainsi qu'à l'exécution et à la livraison de diverses offres de cybersécurité sur les sites clients en fonction des besoins. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment. Job Description Job Description ​ MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the cybersecurity expertise (subject matter expert) for Grid Automation within a given territory / region. Assist the Sales Operations teams in responding to demo requests, RFPs, and other Bid/Tender requests. Stay connected with the market dynamics, engage with GA customers to understand their cybersecurity needs / pain-points, and translate them into new cybersecurity sales opportunities. Present the Grid Automation cybersecurity offerings to customers in a variety of locations – including trade shows and events. Develop sophisticated cybersecurity designs for customer environments. Understand competitors’ offerings, industry trends, customers’ behavior. Be available to be “hands-on” at customer sites to assist in the design, configuration, and installation of a variety of cybersecurity offerings. Promote the GA cybersecurity offerings with utility and industrial customers and the GA sales organization. Drive productive interactions with GA region teams, other GA Product Managers, R&D and product development, Technical Application Engineering, and Commercial teams. Develop, coach, and mentor the regional cybersecurity delivery teams (customer engineers) to strengthen their overall technical and business capabilities. Develop and conduct training on a variety of cybersecurity topics for the Regions and GA staff as needed. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS : Apporter toute son expertise en cybersécurité (être l’expert en la matière) pour l'automatisation des réseaux dans un territoire/une région donnée ; Aider les équipes des opérations commerciales à répondre aux demandes de démonstration, aux appels d'offres et à d'autres demandes d'enchère/d'appel d'offres. Rester connecté/e à la dynamique du marché, communiquer avec les clients de GA pour comprendre leurs besoins et leurs problèmes en matière de cybersécurité, et les traduire en nouvelles opportunités de vente dans le domaine de la cybersécurité ; Présenter les offres de cybersécurité de GA aux clients présents dans différentes localisations et notamment lors de salons professionnels et d'événements. Développer des conceptions en matière de cybersécurité sophistiquées pour les environnements des clients ; Comprendre les offres des concurrents, les tendances du secteur et le comportement des clients ; Etre disponible pour aller sur le terrain, sur les sites clients, afin de les aider à concevoir, à configurer et à installer diverses solutions de cybersécurité ; Promouvoir les offres de cybersécurité de GA auprès des clients des secteurs des services publics et industriels et de l'organisation commerciale de GA ; Favoriser des interactions productives avec les équipes de la région GA, les chefs de produit, les équipes R&D et développement de produits, l'ingénierie des applications techniques et les équipes comerciales ; Développer, coacher et accompagner les équipes régionales de livraison (ingénieurs clients) afin de renforcer leurs capacités techniques et commerciales globales. Élaborer et organiser des formations sur divers sujets liés à la cybersécurité pour les régions et le personnel de GA en fonction des besoins. QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience. Business Administration degree would be an asset ( e.g., MBA). At least some years’ real-world experience in OT cybersecurity versus IT cybersecurity. At least some years’ experience in the energy sector, especially in the industrial protection and control / automation, transmission, distribution, or service fields. Hands-on knowledge of many types of cybersecurity products, solutions, and services and how to sell them for customer adoption. Experience operating as a cybersecurity sales coach, trainer, and overlay (to up-level an uneducated sales organization to promote and sell a variety of cybersecurity offerings) – making a huge impact on growth. At least some years’ experience working with a variety of different types of Channel Partners. Demonstrated experience with Linux, and Microsoft Windows operating systems including user account management, security / system hardening & device control, and patch management. Familiarity with LDAP, RADIUS, TLS, SSH, SFTP, RSA, HTTPS, NERC-CIP, NIST, IEC62443, IEC62351 standards, cyber asset protection regulations and standards, and communication protocols like IEC61850, DNP, IEC60870-5-104 – affecting the utilities industry. Experience with threat modeling techniques and tools. Strong customer service mindset. Experience with operating systems like Microsoft Windows, Linux, and VxWorks. Good writing and oral communication skills. Experience with Microsoft 365 applications ( e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, and Word), Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft SharePoint. Experience with Box, OneDrive, Smartsheet, Adobe, Tableau, and SFDC. Willingness and the ability to participate in video meetings that occasionally happen early in the morning, or later in the evening. Willingness and ability to travel within Europe - approximately 20% - 50%. QUALIFICATIONS/EXIGENCES : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie électrique ou en génie informatique ou expérience professionnelle équivalente Un diplôme en administration des affaires serait un atout (ex. MBA) A minima quelques années d'expérience concrète en matière de cybersécurité OT par rapport à la cybersécurité informatique A minima quelques années d'expérience dans le secteur de l'énergie, notamment dans les domaines de la protection industrielle et du contrôle/automatisation, de la transmission, de la distribution ou des services Connaissance pratique de nombreux types de produits, de solutions et de services de cybersécurité et de la manière de les vendre pour qu'ils soient adoptés par les clients Expérience en tant que Coach commercial, formateur/trice et superviseur en cybersécurité (pour développer une organisation commerciale afin de promouvoir et de vendre une variété d'offres de cybersécurité), pour avoir un impact considérable sur la croissance. A minima quelques années d'expérience de travail en collaboration avec différents types de partenaires de distribution. Expérience démontrée avec les systèmes d'exploitation Linux et Microsoft Windows, y compris la gestion des comptes utilisateurs, le renforcement de la sécurité/du système et le contrôle des appareils, ainsi que la gestion des correctifs. Connaissance des normes LDAP, RADIUS, TLS, SSH, SFTP, RSA, HTTPS, NERC-CIP, NIST, IEC62443, IEC62351, des réglementations et normes de protection des cyberactifs et des protocoles de communication tels que IEC61850, DNP, IEC60870-5-104, qui ont une incidence sur le secteur des services publics. Expérience des techniques et des outils de modélisation des menaces. Solide état d'esprit en matière de service client. Expérience avec des systèmes d'exploitation tels que Microsoft Windows, Linux et VxWorks. Bonnes compétences en rédaction et en communication orale. Expérience avec les applications Microsoft 365 (par exemple, Excel, PowerPoint et Word), Microsoft Teams et Microsoft SharePoint). Expérience avec Box, OneDrive, Smartsheet, Adobe, Tableau et SFDC. Volonté et capacité à participer à des réunions vidéo qui ont parfois lieu tôt le matin ou tard dans la soirée. Volonté et capacité de voyager en Europe : environ 20 % à 50 %. DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS: Ability to work comfortably in a global organization with people from many different cultures and backgrounds. Bi-lingual or multilingual is highly desired, and a huge plus. Ability to interface with, and influence all levels of the customer’s organization, as well as other internal GE Vernova functions, and be able to converse in detail about a broad amount of cybersecurity topics. Has a good handle on where the cybersecurity industry is headed, when, and why. Strong account management, sales, and consulting presence. Strong customer advisory (trusted advisor) and advocacy skills. Strong business acumen and commercial savvy. Strong customer service mindset – customer first mentality. Strong business and financial acumen and operating background. Solid oral and written communication and training skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Strong team player with a desire to go the extra mile when needed. CARACTÉRISTIQUES SOUHAITÉES : Capacité à travailler confortablement dans une organisation mondiale composée de personnes de cultures et d'horizons différents. Le bilinguisme ou le multilinguisme est fortement souhaité, c'est un avantage considérable. Capacité à interagir avec tous les niveaux de l'organisation du client, ainsi qu'avec d'autres fonctions internes de GE Vernova, et à interagir en détail sur un large éventail de sujets liés à la cybersécurité. Une bonne compréhension du secteur de la cybersécurité, comment le gérer, quand et pourquoi. Solides compétence en matière de gestion des comptes, des ventes et de conseil. Solides compétences en matière de conseil à la clientèle (conseiller de confiance) et de plaidoyer. Sens aigu des affaires Un solide état d'esprit en matière de service à la clientèle clientèle, priorité client Solide sens des affaires, des finances et expérience opérationnelle. Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite Compétences dans la formation Solides compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership Solide esprit d'équipe avec l’envie de se dépasser lorsque nécessaire Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. title: Sales Leader Poland/ Baltics & Eastern Europe - Onshore Wind
jd_text: Job Description Summary At GE Vernova, we are accelerating the energy transition by electrifying the world while advancing decarbonization. As a global energy company spanning Power, Wind, and Electrification, we help customers around the world deliver reliable, affordable, and more sustainable energy. As a Senior Sales Leader, you will play a key role in your region in driving business growth and building strategic customer partnerships across a dynamic and evolving energy landscape. Operating within a global organization with a presence on six continents and an expanding portfolio of technologies and services, you will help shape commercial strategies that enable customers to meet their energy and sustainability goals. Join us and be part of a team that is delivering the energy systems of today while helping create a more sustainable future for generations to come. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities: Responsible for onshore wind turbine sales in Poland, the Baltics, and Eastern Europe Create close working relationships with all key stakeholders at assigned accounts across the Region and develop a thorough understanding of their project strategies and needs. Provide commercial and technical support to assigned accounts with their project strategy. Ensure GE Vernova’s Onshore Wind products and services have a favourable consideration in all assigned or newly created accounts’ wind projects. Identify, develop, and close sales opportunities within assigned accounts. Identify, understand, and communicate to the Onshore Wind management, customer requirements from both project-specific and their business in general. Work effectively in a team environment with Commercial Operations, Technical Operations, and Engineering, Finance, and Project Management to ensure the most efficient use of all resources. Use judgment to make decisions or solve complex tasks or problems within projects, product lines, markets, sales processes etc. Utilize multiple internal and available external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions. Leverage technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Be accountable for orders, pricing/profitability, risk, terms & conditions, and customer satisfaction. Manage the Inquiry to Order ("ITO") process for assigned accounts. Maintain data quality and accuracy of current project(s), opportunities, and customer information in the sales database system. Participate in and support trade shows, conferences, and other related business events. Key measurements will include: Accountability of business operation plan relative to assigned markets: Region Orders, Margins, and Cash Operating Plan. Creating and maintaining pipeline. Performance to Goals & Objectives (developed in cooperation with Region Sales Leader). Sales Database accuracy and Data Quality. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering related to energy projects, Finance, and/or an advanced business degree with applicable renewable industry experience. Extensive experience and a proven track record of relevant sales and business development achievements in the wind power industry. Practical understanding of current/emerging requirements of the power generation markets and customer financial drivers and needs. Strong communication skills and confidence with executive-level presentations. Strong interpersonal, team-building, and negotiation skills; ability to work with colleagues and customers at all levels of the organizations. Flexible for frequent travel throughout the country and region (30+) Consistent track record of meeting performance objectives. Self-starter with high energy and ability to energize others, drive change, work independently, and in the team. Fluency in Polish and English. What we offer: Employment based on an employment contract. Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international and future- oriented environment. Open and supportive corporate culture that promotes creativity and teamwork. Flexible working hours and independent work. Attractive compensation package including company car and sales bonus. title: Senior Commercial Proposal Manager - NAM
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Senior Commercial Proposal Manager drives functional and operational Commercial Intensity and Policy 5.0 rigor for assigned deal opportunities. The Senior Commercial Proposal Manager will manage the quoting, proposal generation, contract negotiation, and ITO-OTR turnover processes for all assigned deal opportunities of the assigned segment and sub-region. In this role you will be responsible for work that is less defined in scope and have the understanding and experience to execute business objectives, be involved in short-term and long-term planning and contribute to the overall business strategy. Job Description Key Responsibilities Work as a key member of the region and/or sub-region Inquiry to Order (“ITO”) team in support of achieving the region’s and/or sub-region’s commitments, orders, sales, cash, operating profit, and margin targets for the applicable segment. Working with the region and/or sub-region Sales, Operations, and functional teams, lead the ITO proposal generation and contract formation process for projects across the segment with the intent of developing winning strategies to leverage successful deal closures while ensuring compliance with established guidelines for the Policy 5.0 risk management process, the advance release process. Be responsible for effectively driving the proposal and contract ITO processes to develop scope, cost, risk, and market / value pricing strategy for an assigned deal opportunity to provide technical and commercial solutions meeting both customer and GEV’s requirements and business goals. Collaborate with the respective sales, operations, and other functional teams during the deal development and review process to ensure that all technical risk points, risk mitigation, and business risk acceptance levels are properly incorporated into the development of the opportunity scope, cost, strategy, and actual proposal / contract language Prepare and lead the Sub-Regional/Deal Team Policy 5.0 review process in co-ordination with the applicable Commercial Director, subject matter experts, approvers, and functional teams. Drive and coordinating ITO process compliance and metrics across assigned deal opportunities with special emphasis on Policy 5.0 requirements, proposal and contract completeness, timeliness, and quality, and the effectiveness and efficiency of the ITO-OTR (Inquiry To Order - Order To Remittance) handover process. Drive proposal throughput, yield, cost, efficiency, and individual productivity. Ensure process adherence to all government-contracting requirements with support from GEV legal resources. Enforce order-booking requirements and drive an improved OTR turnover process to ensure proper control of contract flow-down requirements. Be responsible for reducing cost-of-quality issues arising from inaccurate or poor scope definition, costing, or contract drafting during the ITO process and inadequate handovers during the ITO-OTR handover and advance release process for assigned deal opportunities. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business from an accredited university or college Minimum 8 years of experience in Power generation equipment with a focus on sales, commercial operations, engineering or execution operations Desired Characteristics Minimum 5 years of Deep Heavy Duty product knowledge and commercial experience and direct customer relationships Experience managing and communicating/presenting complex programs or projects with problem-solving abilities with all level management Commercial/sales/project related experience with complex Gas Turbine service solutions in the Power Generation and/or Energy Industry Experience within both the Multi-Year Contractual and Transactional Services businesses preferred Experience managing large complex deals with multi-functional interactions. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple individual and team responsibilities for multiple complex projects. Excellent technical and/or commercial writing and reading comprehension skills. title: Site Manager - Electrical/Infrastructure
jd_text: Job Description Summary Are you ready to lead the infrastructure projects powering the energy transition? We are seeking a proactive Site Manager to join our Power Conversion team. In this role, you will be the technical and operational heartbeat of our industrial projects, leading field teams and ensuring the successful delivery of complex electrification systems. If you are a collaborative leader who thrives on site and takes pride in operational excellence, we invite you to help us build a more sustainable future. Job Description What you will accomplish You will be the primary point of contact for the end-to-end site lifecycle, from initial tender to final commissioning. You will: Lead Project Planning: Shape the success of our projects by coordinating site scheduling, estimating costs for installation work, and planning infrastructure requirements during the tender phase. Drive Execution: Manage the mobilization of site teams, oversee construction progress, and ensure that our "Construction Operating Rhythm" is consistently applied across all project sites. Champion Safety and Quality: Uphold our unwavering commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental standards. You will proactively manage risks, perform quality inspections, and ensure all contractors meet our high performance and safety benchmarks. Collaborate and Communicate: Act as a bridge between design offices and site teams, ensuring data flows efficiently and that stakeholders are kept informed through accurate, timely progress reporting. Manage Field Operations: Take ownership of site budgets and staffing plans, ensuring that our technical solutions are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest standards of quality. The value you will bring You are a natural leader with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for electrical engineering. You excel in fast-paced, site-based environments where clear communication and rigorous planning are essential. Your ability to anticipate challenges, manage complex contractor relationships, and mentor team members ensures that every project not only meets its technical goals but also fosters a culture of safety and operational excellence. What you need to succeed We are looking for someone who brings significant experience in managing site operations for large-scale electrical installations. Key requirements include: Substantive experience as a Site or Construction Manager, ideally within an electrical engineering environment. Working knowledge of the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM 2015). Familiarity with the installation and commissioning of electrical equipment, such as switchgear, transformers, or rotating machines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and project management software. Relevant safety certification, such as NEBOSH for Construction (or similar). A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel frequently to project sites across the UK and Ireland. A degree in Electrical Engineering is beneficial; however, we value significant, relevant hands-on experience just as highly. Why join us? At our Power Conversion business, we provide the electrification systems that are critical to the world’s energy, maritime, and industrial organizations. You will join a global team dedicated to decarbonization and efficiency, working on challenging projects that make a real-world difference. We offer a flexible, remote-friendly work environment and a comprehensive benefits package—including employer pension contributions, private health insurance, and life assurance—tailored to support your personal and professional needs. Ready to make an impact? Apply today to lead the projects that are shaping the future of energy. We look forward to seeing the expertise you will bring to our team.

title: Site Manager/ Bauleiter (all genders) für Umspannwerks- Projekte
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description GE Vernova befindet sich in einer Phase des Hyper-Wachstums. Wir skalieren unsere Teams, bauen neue Bereiche auf und heben unsere Branche auf das nächste Level. Werden Sie Teil dieser Mission! Bei GE Vernova Grid Solutions elektrifizieren wir die Welt mit fortschrittlichen Netztechnologien. Als führendes Unternehmen im Energiesektor ist es unser Ziel, den Übergang zu einem energieeffizienteren Stromnetz zu beschleunigen, um die Anforderungen von morgen zu erfüllen. Mit Fokus auf Wachstum und Nachhaltigkeit spielt GE Vernova Grid Solutions eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in das Netz, um den Weg zur Klimaneutralität zu ebnen. Aufgrund des Wachstums unseres AC- Umspannwerks/ FACTS Bereiches suchen wir aktuell einen Site Manager/ Bauleiter für Umspannwerks- Projekte (all genders) für den Bereich „Construction & Commissioning“, um gemeinsam an dieser Energiewende mitzuwirken. Ihre Mission: Sie leiten unsere Aktivitäten auf der Baustelle in unseren 110/ 400 kV Umspannwerksprojekten. Sie sind unser Repräsentant vor Ort, sind Ansprechpartner vor Ort für unseren Kunden und koordinieren Ihr Baustellenteam sowie unsere Subunternehmer für Bau- und Montageleistungen. Als Verantwortlicher für die Baustellentätigkeiten und dessen Ausführung tragen Sie maßgeblich dazu bei, dass die Arbeiten im Umspannwerk sicher, in hoher Qualität, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich ausgeführt werden. Die Rolle ist 100 % Baustellenbasiert. Ihre Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten Mobilisierung: Koordination der Mobilisierung von Baustellenpersonal gemeinsam mit internen Abteilungen sowie mit Subunternehmern, sowie Planung der Baustelleneinrichtung Arbeitssicherheit: Planung & Koordination aller Arbeiten auf der Baustelle unter Einhaltung der geltenden Arbeitsschutz-, Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen. Prüfung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen & Method Statements. Baustellensteuerung: Leitung aller Baustellenaktivitäten einschließlich der Führung der Subunternehmer, um für einen reibungslosen Ablauf auf der Baustelle zu sorgen. Kommunikation: Ansprechpartner für unseren Kunden sowie Leitung der Baubesprechungen. Kontrolle & Reporting: Überwachung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen während der Bauausführung und entsprechendes Reporting an die Projektleitung. Chancen & Risiken: Identifizierung und Management von Risiken und Chancen in Bezug auf Montageaktivitäten and entsprechendes Reporting an die Projektleitung. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich der Elektrotechnik mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung, idealerweise Weiterbildung zum Techniker/ Meister. Erfahrung als Bauleiter in Umspannwerksprojekten oder vergleichbaren Projekten, z.B. Oil & Gas, Kraftwerke, oder in der Montage von Hochspannungskomponenten wünschenswert Starkes Bewusstsein für Gesundheit und Sicherheit (EHS) gemäß internationalen Standards; die Fähigkeit, unsichere Arbeit zu identifizieren und zu stoppen, wird vorausgesetzt. Ausgeprägte zwischenmenschliche Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten, gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit zu klarer Berichterstattung Lean Mindset: Offen für Weiterbildungen, neue Tools und Verbesserungen Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands und der Niederlande Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil Führerschein Klasse B Warum wir bei GE Vernova arbeiten: Bei GE Vernova nehmen unsere Mitarbeitenden jede Herausforderung an – wir sind stets bestrebt, die bestmögliche Lösung zu finden. Unsere Projekte sind einzigartig und spannend, weshalb Sie einen lösungsorientierten und positiven Ansatz mitbringen sollten. Umgeben von engagierten Kollegen und der Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen, arbeiten Sie an wegweisenden Projekten, die einen echten Beitrag zur Energiewende leisten. Was wir bieten Berufliche Weiterentwicklung: Dynamisches Team, umfangreiche Ressourcen und Trainings zur Kompetenzentwicklung. Boomende Branche mit Cutting-Edge-Projekten: Mitarbeit an hochkarätigen, innovativen Projekten. Globale Perspektive: Zusammenarbeit mit einem vielfältigen, globalen Netzwerk von Branchenexperten. Kollaboratives Umfeld: Unterstützende Unternehmenskultur, die Kreativität und Teamarbeit fördert. Kultur mit Eigenverantwortung: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine stabile Karriereperspektive. Wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket sowie attraktive Unternehmensleistungen. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

title: Sr Project Management Manager - Project Mgmt
jd_text: Job Description Summary As a Senior Project Manager, you will take ownership for managing the full project life-cycle of our Controls Projects within the Software & Controls Solutions business. Working in collaboration with customers, you will lead and inspire your teams, both internal and external, to deliver complex and innovative projects. The Senior Project Manager has the overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, reporting, controlling and closure of a project and acts as the primary customer contact for all assigned projects. A Senior Project Manager is also responsible for driving the growth and development of the Software & Controls Solutions business within Korea, delivering exceptional service to customers, ensuring customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
